full_prompt_en: An experimental black-and-white photograph looks down a long, vaulted public hall where people and architecture blur into ghostly layers. Tall columns and arched ceilings recede toward a bright vanishing point at the upper center. Tables and chairs line both sides of a central passage, with pale cloths and small lamps appearing as fragmented highlights. Several dark human silhouettes stand or move through the foreground; their outlines repeat and smear vertically as though the camera held multiple moments in one exposure. The floor reflects some of this activity in long gray streaks, dissolving the distinction between bodies and shadows. Farther back, the hall becomes increasingly luminous and indistinct, with bright haze swallowing the details of the far arches. The image has no single sharply frozen event. It emphasizes the shared rhythm of movement within a large, old interior: the architecture supplies steady vertical and curved lines, while people become soft, shifting marks. Grain and slight optical flare add a worn silver surface, and the tonal range moves from deep charcoal at the sides to milky white in the distance. Light appears to pour from the far end and upper vault, spreading unevenly through the crowd. The whole frame feels haunted by ordinary life, a place remembered through overlapping movement rather than captured in a single instant.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅实验性黑白摄影沿着一座长而有拱顶的公共大厅望去，人群与建筑模糊成幽影般的层次。高柱与拱形天花板朝上方中央的明亮消失点后退。桌椅沿中央通道两侧排列，浅色桌布与小灯化作破碎的高光。几道深色人影在前景站立或移动；轮廓竖向重复、拖散，仿佛相机把多个时刻收进一次曝光。地面把部分活动反射成长长的灰色条纹，使身体与阴影的区别逐渐消失。更远处，大厅越来越发亮、越来越模糊，亮雾吞没远方拱顶细节。画面没有一个被清晰冻结的事件。它强调巨大旧室内中共同的运动节奏：建筑提供稳定的竖线与弧线，人群则成为柔软、变化的笔迹。颗粒与轻微光学眩光给表面添加磨旧的银色质地，明暗从两侧深炭灰走向远处乳白。光仿佛从远端和上方穹顶涌入，不均匀地穿过人群。整幅画像被日常生活的幽灵萦绕，一处地方通过重叠运动被记住，而非在单一瞬间被捕获。
style_prompt_en: The experimental monochrome photograph layers stable receding curves and verticals with blurred, repeated dark marks. A central lane pulls toward a high milky vanishing glow, while the sides hold charcoal mass and fragments of small pale highlights. Long exposure or multiple-exposure softness stretches some forms vertically and makes others nearly transparent. Reflections below echo the moving marks without resolving into clear duplicates. Fine film grain and slight flare give the silver-gray values a worn tactile surface. The strongest structure lies in the symmetrical recession, but offset overlapping ghosts prevent rigid order. Details become steadily less distinct toward the luminous distance. Light appears to enter from deep within the frame and spread through haze. The whole frame feels memory-like and quietly uncanny through blurred time, layered movement, and disciplined architectural rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅实验性黑白摄影把稳定后退的弧线与竖线，同模糊、重复的深色笔迹层叠。一道中央通路拉向高处乳白色消失亮光，两侧保持炭灰体量和细小浅色高光碎片。长曝光或多重曝光般的柔软感将部分形体竖向拖长，让另一些几乎透明。下方倒影呼应移动痕迹，却没有变成清楚复制。细胶片颗粒与轻微眩光使银灰明度具有磨旧的可触表面。最强结构来自对称的纵深，但错位重叠的幽影避免死板秩序。细节越靠近明亮远处越不清楚。光似乎从画面深处进入，穿过薄雾扩散。整幅画通过模糊时间、层叠运动和严谨的结构节奏，显得像记忆一样，安静而略带诡异。
theme_en: Ghostly movement through a grand hall
theme_zh: 宏大厅堂里幽影般的流动
name: Matthew Pillsbury
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
